verdict.rationale: Gazebo's libraries carry major version numbers (e.g. gz-sim10). The docs state that all versions sharing a major number are binary compatible, and they keep a table of currently supported ROS/Gazebo version pairings. That gives a documented API versioning scheme. Nothing in the evidence describes a deprecation policy (notice periods, removal timelines, migration guides). missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, deprecation timelines/migration guidance, explicit API stability guarantees beyond binary compatibility, independent corroboration.
